name: Top 10 Domain Controllers with the Most Login Failure Rate

search.queryText:
_sourceCategory = Labs/windows-jsonformat  "\"Channel\":\"Security\"" (4624 or 4625 or 4771 or 4776 or 4768 or 4769)  _sourceName=Security
// 4624 - Login Success, 4625 or 4771 - Login Failures, 4776 - Domain Controller - Credential validation, 4768 - A Kerberos authentication ticket (TGT) was requested, 4769 - A Kerberos service ticket was requested
| json "EventID", "Computer", "Level", "Message", "Keywords", "Channel" as event_id, host, event_type, msg_summary, Keywords, channel nodrop
| where event_id in ("4624", "4625", "4771", "4776", "4768", "4769")
| if (Keywords matches "Audit Success", 1, 0) as Success 
| if (Keywords matches "Audit Failure", 1, 0) as Failure 
| _sourceHost as ReportingDC 
| count as LoginAttempts, sum(Success) as SuccessLoginAttempts, sum(Failure) as FailureLoginAttempts by ReportingDC 
| FailureLoginAttempts / LoginAttempts as %"LoginFailureRatio" | sort - %"LoginFailureRatio" | limit 10
